contract.await: queued on parent executor, including completed dependencies; no blocking or inline cross-executor resume
contract.cancellation: cooperative wakeup; shared dependency continues; stale lifetime tokens cannot access a freed frame
contract.ownership: native coroutine frame, aligned locals/results, retained Objective-C values, Block captures and captured exceptions
contract.worker_autorelease: pool per executor callback when Objective-C runtime is linked; pure C/C++ service library has weak pool references
contract.native_exceptions: GNU primary exception reference counting owns the native header and thrown Objective-C object through capture and dependent rethrow

compiler_foundation_reused.basis: same verified LLVM/Clang compiler contents and source build identity; compiler source was not changed

native_validation.scope: Native Clang foundation checks; feature claims follow schemas/objc3-language-capabilities.json.

installed_source_modules.limits: Example module graph, not a general package manager. Build timings exclude full SDK admission and final verification; elapsed timings include both. The native linker runs on every invocation.
